scope: For a finite simplicial poset and a downward subposet, the associated graded of the degree-j piece of the i-th relative parameter Tor module is linearly equivalent to the direct sum of reduced relative cohomology over the rank sets of total degree j. A rank set S contributes in cohomological degree |S| − i − 1. The coefficient ring may be any commutative ring.
known_gaps: Equivariance, products, and the Grothendieck-group consequences require separate comparisons.
